response: The body mass index (BMI) is one of the prognostic factors of stage 2 and stage 3a gastric cancer. However, it does not appear to be useful for determining the prognosis of stage 1a, 1b, 3b, and 4a gastric cancers. This suggests that BMI has an influence on morbidity and long-term survival in certain stages of gastric cancer patients after gastrectomy, but its impact is limited to specific stages of the disease.
